Append to p9-q4: (d) Find the x-intercept of the tangent to y=2e^x at x=2. Answer: x=1. (e) Find the x-intercept of the tangent to y=e^{2x} at x=2. Answer: x=3/2. (f) Find the x-intercept of the tangent to y=e^{ax} at x=t, where a≠0. Answer: x=t-1/a.
